patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: とろー is a dialect or old-man form of ている, for an ongoing or repeated action. が adds an irritated tone. いっとろーが = 'I've been telling you!'.

patterns.name: 〜と (quoting)
patterns.explanation: と after words marks what was said. The quote itself is left out here. と　いっとろーが = 'I told you (that)!'.
